[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=The Eternal Grove | page name suffix=explorable area | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=128 }} [[The Eternal Grove (explorable area)|The Eternal Grove]] is a sacred location for the [[Kurzick]]s. This deep part of the [[Echovald Forest]] is where the [[Forever Tree]]s grow -- the trees that contain the magic to transform Kurzick volunteers into [[Kurzick Juggernaut]]s. The actual explorable area is much larger than the area accessible during [[The Eternal Grove|the mission]], minus the mission starting location (the gates to which are locked). The primary inhabitants in this area are hostile [[Plant]]s and the [[Warden]]s, with a small group of [[Mantid]]s around a small stream and lake near the center. ==Getting there== Exit from [[Vasburg Armory]] or travel north from [[Amatz Basin (outpost)|Amatz Basin]] via [[Mourning Veil Falls]]. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with bounties: *[[Kurzick Priest]] → [[Blessing of the Kurzicks]]
